title: The Signal From Space Nobody Has Heard Since #Shorts

hook.narration: In nineteen seventy-seven, a radio telescope heard a signal from space, and it has never been heard again.

visuals.prompt: A huge radio telescope dish under a star-filled night sky in Ohio, faint green aurora, 1977

scenes.narration: On fifteenth August, nineteen seventy-seven, Ohio State's Big Ear radio telescope was scanning the sky for signs of alien life.

visuals.prompt: A huge flat radio telescope in an open field at night, beneath the Milky Way
Hands of a 1970s astronomer adjusting dials in a control room full of computers

scenes.narration: Days later, volunteer astronomer Jerry Ehman was reading the printouts when he found a burst far stronger than the usual noise. He circled it and wrote one word beside it: Wow!

visuals.prompt: A 1970s computer printout with columns of numbers, one line circled in red ink, close-up, desk lamp
A red pen writing a single word in the margin of a printout

scenes.narration: The signal lasted seventy-two seconds, the full time the telescope could watch that patch of sky, and it came from the direction of Sagittarius.

visuals.prompt: A starry sky centred on the constellation Sagittarius, glowing galactic core

scenes.narration: Astronomers searched that spot again and again. Nothing. Its source is still unexplained.

visuals.prompt: Radio telescope dishes aimed at a dark sky, long exposure star trails, silence and mystery

description: In 1977, a radio telescope in Ohio picked up a strong signal that has never been heard again. Here is the story of the Wow! signal. #Shorts #History #Space

thumbnail.prompt: A computer printout with one line circled in red under a starry sky, mysterious glow
